style: Sound effect for a cozy, whimsical pixel-art fantasy card game: soft, warm and gentle, clean and close-up, dry with no reverb tail, no voices

clips.prompt: A paper card pack being torn open in one quick satisfying rip, crinkly foil wrapper, with a tiny soft pop at the end
A single playing card sliding quickly across a wooden table, a light papery swish
A single playing card flipped over with a crisp light snap of thick paper
A tiny soft wooden tick, like a little wooden bead tapping a table, very short
One soft high glass chime, a small bright ding that fades quickly
Two quick rising sparkly glockenspiel notes with a soft shimmer, magical and pleased
A magical rising harp glissando ending in a warm bright chime with sparkles, exciting reveal
A triumphant golden magical reveal: a soft whoosh rising into a bright bell chord with shimmering sparkles, joyful and grand but gentle
A mystical cosmic reveal: a deep soft swell rising into a choir-like shimmering bell chord with twinkling stars, awe and wonder
A quick bright metallic glint shimmer, a light sparkle sweep like light catching shiny foil
A rising rainbow shimmer: many tiny crystal bells cascading upward in a sweeping glittering wash
A soft magical implosion: air being sucked inward into a small dark hole, a low hollow whoomp at the end
A short digital glitch: retro 8-bit computer stutter, bitcrushed chirps and a quick static crackle
A tiny very soft wooden tick, a barely-there click for hovering over a button
A soft satisfying wooden button press, a muted wooden clack
A few small gold coins clinking together into a little pile, bright and cheerful
A small crystal gem being picked up, a clear bright crystalline ting with a tiny sparkle
Soft magical dust swirling into a pouch, a gentle airy sparkly whoosh
Two magical cards fusing together: a swirling magical whoosh building up into a warm bright chime
A soft gentle low wooden double-bonk, a friendly 'not quite' sound, not harsh
